name: Stopping!!! 5 Hataraku Onee-san Hen
original_name: ストッピング!!!5 はたらくおねえさん編
source:
Is an animated novel for adults in which a man with the ability to stop time does whatever he pleases to an unresisting girl. He defiles the bodies of girls in various occupations and uniforms.
